purpose: Owner-only product strategy evidence. This is not a legal conclusion, endorsement, market-share claim, or permission to copy competitor branding or content.

competitors.name: LegalZoom
competitors.adaptation: Keep optional service bundles visible only after operational gates pass; preserve fee separation and no automatic professional relationship.

competitors.name: Rocket Lawyer
competitors.adaptation: Continue device-only preparation and exact-source tools; do not imply automated contract analysis is professional advice.

competitors.name: Avvo
competitors.adaptation: Preserve source transparency and claim/correction workflows while keeping reviews inactive until verification and moderation controls are proven.

competitors.name: FindLaw and Lawyers.com
competitors.adaptation: Improve plain-language path comparison and multilingual readiness without importing copyrighted articles or paid ranking logic.

competitors.name: LawHelp.org / Pro Bono Net
competitors.adaptation: Make nonprofit legal aid and court/agency help first-class options rather than treating private counsel as the default.

competitors.name: LegalMatch
competitors.adaptation: Use preparation tools but do not create or transmit a case, lead, or lawyer match without explicit user action and an opened routing gate.

competitors.name: Clio Grow and Lawmatics
competitors.adaptation: Retain professional workflow foundations, but keep booking, confidential intake, and automated follow-up closed until production operations are ready.

approvedAdaptations: Neutral Legal Help Options Navigator covering self-help, court or agency help, nonprofit legal aid, limited-scope assistance, one-time consultation, and full representation.
Clear comparison of fit, limits, preparation steps, cost questions, and relationship boundaries.
Owner-only competitor watchlist with dated sources and explicit non-copying rules.
Professional profile transparency, neutral ordering, correction and claim paths, and explicit participation status remain differentiators.
rejectedPatterns: Paid or sponsored status influencing organic directory order.
Unverified ratings, testimonials, case results, or outcome promises.
Automatic lead creation, lawyer notification, or confidential case transmission.
Bundled paid services before staffing, security, payment, support, and legal gates pass.
Copying competitor text, layouts, scoring methods, branding, or proprietary content.
